_note: confirmed: values confirmed by the user (logs/decisions.md, internal). provisional: temporary values before confirmation (DEV checks only). If provisional is not empty, EVAL runs are refused (src/medgapqa/agent.py load_config).

confirmed.T_rule: v2: conditions with tools get the sum of the tool limits + 1 (C2 3, C3 3, C4 5); C0 and C1 get T (4). v1: T for every condition
confirmed.simulator_design: D2: the LLM only classifies the question as WITHHELD/IN_CASE/NOT_AVAILABLE; the reply sentences are fixed texts
confirmed.repeat_limit_policy: v2: one retry with a fixed sentence; still over the limit after the retry -> unresolved ({ask,search}_limit_after_retry). v1: unresolved immediately
confirmed.forced_answer_prompt: You have reached the action limit. Answer now with one option letter.
confirmed.last_turn_policy: v2: on the last turn only ANSWER/ABSTAIN (those allowed in the condition), fixed sentence 'This is your last action. Choose ...'; a tool attempt is unresolved after one retry (last_turn_tool_after_retry)
confirmed.forced_answer: v2: disabled (code kept to reproduce v1)
